newsitem.title: USA: Aerial launches Minneapolis PCS service.
newsitem.headline: Aerial launches Minneapolis PCS service.

text.p: Aerial Communications Inc said Monday it launched its digital Personal Communications Services (PCS) wireless phone service in the Minneapolis/St. Paul area.
Aerial said service will initially be available in the seven-county Twin Cities metropolitan area, as well as nearby St. Cloud, Minnesota and Menomonie, Wisconsin.
Aerial now offers service in three areas, including Austin, Texas and its first market, Columbus, Ohio, where it said sales are ahead of plan.
The company said it will launch service in Kansas City, Pittsburgh and Tampa during the current second quarter.
